svg.title: Measured quality. scripts/evaluate.py scores retrieval against 41 hand labelled paraphrases (none copied from the knowledge base), 12 off topic questions and 5 competitor fund house questions. Top 1 accuracy 92.7% (38 of 41) against a floor of 85%. Top 3 accuracy 100% (41 of 41), floor 95%. Answered above the confidence floor 97.6% (40 of 41), floor 90%. Off topic rejected 100% (12 of 12), floor 100%. Competitor questions scoped 100% (5 of 5), floor 100%. The script exits non zero when any floor is breached, and CI runs it on every push alongside 111 tests on Python 3.11 and 3.12.

div.h2: Quality is a build gate, not a claim

div.span: hand labelled paraphrases, none copied from the corpus
off topic questions that must be rejected
questions about other fund houses that must be scoped out
pytest tests, run by CI on Python 3.11 and 3.12

div.div:
$ python scripts/evaluate.py
exits non zero if any floor breaks
